item.title: Huawei and Shaanxi Telecom Put Dual-Band 32T32R FDD Massive MIMO on High-Speed Rail

item.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro Lands on Tencent WorkBuddy and TokenHub With a 1M Context Window

item.title: Xiaomi Open-Sources Xiaomi-Lens-0, a 4B Model That Points to Image Regions Pixel by Pixel
item.description: Xiaomi's SeerRay-Lab open-sourced Xiaomi-Lens-0, a 4B multimodal model on Qwen3.5-4B that emits mask tokens for pixel-level regions mid-answer. It also released the LensBench benchmark.

item.title: Peking University and PrimeBot's HIL-UMI Collects Robot Correction Data Without a Robot Arm
item.description: Peking University and PrimeBot's HIL-UMI uses a handheld gripper to collect robot correction data when a policy disagrees with a human demo. The team claims about 5.6x efficiency versus HG-DAgger.

item.title: Ant Group and vLLM Open-Source Humming, Quantized Inference Kernels With Zhenwu 810E Support
item.description: Ant Group and the vLLM community open-sourced Humming, a JIT GEMM kernel library for quantized inference. It covers INT1-8 and FP4-FP8 mixes and fully supports T-Head's Zhenwu 810E.
